notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Pine survey row is the only tower-specific source, and it gives no build year and no removal date, so the events list is empty by design. The Wikipedia nursery history is about the nursery, not the tower, and no source says when the tower stood there. The survey's alternate names (G.A. Nursery, General Andrews Nursery) are used as written. No corrections to the brief. Lead if more time: Minnesota DNR nursery history or 1930s-1950s Forest Service lookout lists that give a date for the Willow River tower.
